mission.title: rook: Support replacing an OSD based on a metadataDevice that is shared with multiple OSDs on a node
mission.description: Support replacing an OSD based on a metadataDevice that is shared with multiple OSDs on a node. Requested by 11+ users.

steps.title: Check current rook deployment
steps.description:
Verify your rook version and configuration:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n rook -l app.kubernetes.io/name=rook
helm list -n rook 2>/dev/null || echo "Not installed via Helm"
```
This feature requires a working rook installation.

steps.title: Review rook configuration
steps.description:
Inspect the relevant rook configuration:
```bash
kubectl get all -n rook -l app.kubernetes.io/name=rook
kubectl get configmap -n rook -l app.kubernetes.io/part-of=rook
```
**Is this a bug report or feature request?**
* Feature Request

**What should the feature do:**
Rook should allow replacing a single OSD on a node where multiple OSDs are configured to share a metadataDevice.

steps.title: Apply the fix for Support replacing an OSD based on a metadataDevice that is…
steps.description:
As [document](https://rook.io/docs/rook/v1.12/CRDs/Cluster/host-cluster/#specific-nodes-and-devices) mentioned, configuration can be specified at cluster level, the node level or device level config like below. 

cluster level:
```yaml
storage:
    useAllNodes: false
    useAllDevices: false
   
```yaml
ceph-volume lvm batch --prepare <deviceA> <deviceB> <deviceC> --db-devices <metadataDevice>
```

steps.title: Verify the feature works
steps.description:
Test that the new capability is working as expected:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n rook -l app.kubernetes.io/name=rook
kubectl get events -n rook --sort-by='.lastTimestamp' | tail -10
```
Confirm the feature described in "Support replacing an OSD based on a metadataDevice that is…" is functioning correctly.

resolution.summary: As [document](https://rook.io/docs/rook/v1.12/CRDs/Cluster/host-cluster/#specific-nodes-and-devices) mentioned, configuration can be specified at cluster level, the node level or device level config like below.
codeSnippets:
storage:
    useAllNodes: false
    useAllDevices: false
    deviceFilter:
    config:
      metadataDevice: /dev/nmve01
    nodes:
    - name: "172.17.4.201"
      devices:             
      - name: "sdb"
      - name: "sdc1"

storage:
    useAllNodes: false
    useAllDevices: false
    deviceFilter:
    nodes:
    - name: "172.17.4.201"
      config:
        metadataDevice: /dev/nmve01
      devices:             
      - name: "sdb"
      - name: "sdc1"

prerequisites.description: A running Kubernetes cluster with rook installed or the issue environment reproducible.
